# ZoomPhant — Your Monitoring Expert
> AI-Native Time-Series Database (TSDB) & Enterprise All-in-One Monitoring Solution.

ZoomPhant provides two complementary observability and time-series data solutions built for 100% customer data ownership:

1. **ZoomPhant TSDB (Serverless Cloudflare BYOC)**:
   - An AI-native time-series and event database deployed in 1 click inside the user's own Cloudflare account (Workers, Durable Objects, R2).
   - Every deployed instance serves its own machine-readable `/llms.txt` and `/openapi.yaml` so AI agents (Claude, Cursor, custom agents) can push metrics/events, run ZQL correlation queries, and provision dashboards/alerts directly.
   - Ideal for solo builders, startups, small business BI analytics, and AI agent telemetry. First instance is 100% free.
   - Live TSDB Portal & Documentation: https://tsdb.zoomphant.com/docs
   - Machine-Readable TSDB Spec: https://tsdb.zoomphant.com/llms.txt

2. **ZoomPhant Enterprise Monitoring Solution (Self-Hosted & Hybrid)**:
   - A full-scale, single-image enterprise monitoring platform deployed on dedicated servers or private cloud.
   - Handles millions of metrics and log lines per minute across Linux, Windows, Kubernetes, databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka), virtualization (Proxmox VE, VMware), NVIDIA GPUs, and SNMP networks.
   - Free for personal use and registered startups/SMBs; custom SLAs and complimentary pre-implementation consulting available for enterprises.
